text:
jane_marketing: quick sync — planning a combined workshop + credits + prompt-pack experiment the week after launch. goal: boost first-week activation and track 7-day retention. who can own flow mapping and instrumentation?

sam_growth: i can own tracking. need UTM scheme and event names. propose control (no credit) + two credit sizes (starter 50, boost 200).

alex_prod: agree on cohorts. also want to test promptpack included vs opt-in to measure template-driven lift. canary at 10% traffic?

lina_design: ill mock 3 hero images and the workshop slide deck. need a sharp headline and a 1-liner for the reg page.

jane_marketing: headline idea: "Ship LLM features faster — free prompt templates + live workshop" 1-liner: "45-minute workshop to launch a production-ready LLM feature with starter prompts and credits." thoughts?

nina_csm: include a note about "enterprise constraints & security" — many signups will be platform/infra folks. also want a follow-up path for folks who register but don't redeem credits.

sam_growth: tagging plan: utm_campaign=workshop_q2_promptpack, experiment_id=wksh_pp_v1. events to track: registered, attended, credit_redeemed, first_generation, activated_7d.

jane_marketing: standard UTM template: `?utm_source=marketing&utm_medium=workshop&utm_campaign=workshop_q2_promptpack&utm_content={variant}`

alex_prod: routing: attendees who redeem credits -> tailored onboarding flow (prompt templates + quickstarts). non-redeemers -> day 1,3,7 nurture. can we automate triggers?

sam_growth: yes. routing rule pseudo: ```if credit_redeemed -> tag:promptpack_redeemer -> route:pp_onboarding_flow else -> nurture_sequence```

lina_design: launch post copy (short thread + social): "Move faster with Redwood Inference — join our workshop for free prompt templates and credits. RSVP: <link> :rocket:"

jane_marketing: add LinkedIn variant targeted to platform leads: "Secure, predictable LLM inference for production — webinar + prompt-pack + credits to test in your environment."

nina_csm: follow-up drip ideas: Day 1: "Thanks for joining — heres your prompt pack + quickstart" Day 3: "Try these example prompts that sped up iteration" Day 7: "Book an onboarding slot with our team"

sam_growth: A/B cells: A: 50 credits + promptpack (n=500) B: 200 credits + promptpack (n=500) C: promptpack only (n=500) + control. KPIs: 7-day activation, cost-per-activated, avg gens/week.

alex_prod: run experiment for 21 days post-registration to capture early retention. jane, can you pull baseline from last webinar?

jane_marketing: baseline: last webinar 7d activation = 8%, avg gens/week = 3. target: +4 percentage points activation and +1 gen/week.

lina_design: timeline: assets ready Wed, registration page live Fri, promo cadence Mon-Fri the following week, workshop Wed.

nina_csm: ill prepare 3 short customer anecdotes and an onboarding FAQ for attendees.

sam_growth: analytics: ensure `experiment_id` flows to backend event stream. ill share query templates and power calc tomorrow.

jane_marketing: action items: sam - tracking & segmentation; alex - onboarding flow & routing; lina - assets & hero copy; nina - anecdotes & follow-up sequences; me - promo calendar & launch posts.

webinar-bot: Reminder scheduled: registration page live Fri 09:00 UTC. Auto-reminder for registrants 24h before event.

alex_prod: one more thing — draft a benchmark narrative for the internal launch doc: one-paragraph hypothesis, method, expected lift, rollback.

jane_marketing: draft benchmark narrative: "Hypothesis: pairing a concise workshop with immediate credits and ready-to-use prompt templates reduces time-to-value and increases short-term activation. Method: randomized experiment across three variants (credit sizes + promptpack) with tracking for redemption and downstream activity; route redeemers to a focused onboarding flow. Expected lift: +4ppt in 7-day activation and ~25% increase in weekly generations for redeemers. Rollback: if activation or usage drops vs control at 21 days, pause credit spend and revert routing to baseline nurture."

sam_growth: looks good. ill add sample size/power and required n.

jane_marketing: thanks all ill create the experiment doc and post link when ready. :thumbsup:
